name: AUIB Society of Arts and Letters

meta.source: SAL brand overhaul v6 (October 24, 2026), on SAL-BRD-01 v4 and the v5 Screens amendment

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: AUIB crimson. The Bookmark, one italic word, one button, one band per page. 7.8:1 on `white`, 7.0:1 on `paper`. Never text or the symbol on `ink` (1.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: AUIB ink. Text, the footer, dark mode. 13.2:1 with `white` either way round.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The page for everything; text on `ink` and `crimson`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Qirtas's page and long reading only. `ink` 11.8:1, `crimson` 7.0:1, `ash` 5.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers on light grounds. Never text.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on `white` (6.0:1) and `paper` (5.3:1).

tokens.name: crimson-700
tokens.usage: Reserved: the wordmark color inside the logo files only. Not for layouts.

tokens.name: crimson-100
tokens.usage: Rose. The accent on `ink` (8.8:1) and the reversed wordmarks; on `crimson` 5.2:1. Never a background tint.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ink` (7.9:1) in dark mode.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on `ink` in dark mode. Never text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. White in light mode, ink in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-reading
tokens.usage: Qirtas pages and long reading.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on `surface`: 13.2:1 both ways.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, labels, ledes in gray: 6.0:1 light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one loud thing: italic headline word, primary button, Bookmark marker, links in hover. Rose on ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` button: 7.8:1 light, 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: One full-bleed band per page at most: a call, an open submission.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on `band` (7.8:1). Secondary text on band: `crimson-100` (5.2:1).

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: The site footer and the invitation band: ink in both modes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The home page's motto and one-word bands ("Come in."). Scales down to 56 px on phones. One italic `accent` word at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: About, Join, an article headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles beside the Bookmark marker.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: The Open Call for directors closes
styles.usage: List items and card titles: an event, a story.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A bilingual society for literature, theater and the arts.
styles.usage: One sentence under a title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Membership is free and open to every AUIB student.
styles.usage: Running text and interface copy, 60–70 characters a line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small tracked capitals: kickers, dates under numerals, footer headings. Never sentences, never Arabic.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Bylines, captions and meta in `text-secondary`.

styles.name: print-display
styles.usage: 58 pt. Cover and section titles, Light, in `ink`.

styles.name: print-lede
styles.sample: Eighteen articles that keep the Society open to every student.
styles.usage: 17 pt. One sentence under a title.

styles.name: print-heading
styles.usage: 18 pt. Headings within a page.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Any enrolled AUIB student can join. No fee, no audition, no portfolio.
styles.usage: 10.5 pt. Body text.

styles.name: print-caption
styles.usage: 8.5 pt. Captions and notes in `text-secondary`.

styles.name: print-label
styles.usage: Small tracked labels on forms and covers.

styles.name: post-display
styles.usage: Two or three words with a full stop. One italic word at most.

styles.name: post-lede
styles.sample: Poems, stories, essays, photographs and drawings.
styles.usage: One sentence under the headline.

styles.name: post-meta
styles.usage: Date, place and @auibsal at bottom left.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic headlines and the motto beside English display. Regular, never tracked.

styles.name: ar-heading
styles.usage: Arabic headings, one step larger than the English beside them.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: العضوية مجانية ومفتوحة لكل طلبة الجامعة.
styles.usage: Arabic body text, one step larger than `body`.

styles.name: ar-post
styles.usage: The one line of Arabic at the bottom right of every post.

styles.name: read-dek
styles.sample: The Society folds its journal, news and art into one paper.
styles.usage: The standfirst under a Qirtas headline.

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: For its first term, the Society is putting everything it publishes in one place.
styles.usage: Article text in Qirtas, in two columns on wide screens.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Document codes, form numbers, six-word typewriter lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines; button padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between items in a list; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a title and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around the invitation band and the hero.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large page openings.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: A4 side margins (21 mm).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, images, cards, print.

tokens.name: radius-avatar
tokens.usage: Profile pictures and avatars only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule: under the header, between list rows, on forms, footers.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The same weight in `text` color for masthead and section-title rules.
